Concept demo — sample products, sample courier, no real purchase/delivery
Concept demo · v0.1.0

MAXHOSA AFRICA app

A working prototype of the app’s shopping, styling, events and delivery journeys. Every product, price, order and courier event is sample data; nothing leaves this file.

Try it like a phone:

  • Drag any sheet by its handle — flick it down to dismiss.
  • Swipe from the left edge of a pushed screen to go back.
  • Tap a product photo, then pinch or double-tap to zoom.
  • Swipe the events calendar sideways to change month.
  • Press the menu button (top left) and drag to an item, then lift to choose it.
